title: AttemptOutputRefusal
description: The payload of attempt.output_refused/v1 (docs/design/m0/09 "Blob exchange"): the controller refused one adapter output. The event's subject is the attempt. It is not a transition: it leaves the attempt record unchanged and may follow any state, terminal ones included, so it is a record of its own rather than a lease-event transition. An attempt with at least one such event is untrustworthy; M0 derives that at read time. reason is stale_attempt exactly when check is (05 fencing), unsafe_output otherwise.

handle.description: The handle as the adapter declared it (adapter/event.json AdapterHandle), with its name unconstrained so that a path refusal can record it; for foreign_handle its attempt is not the event's.

check.description: The first check that refused the output, in 09's ingestion order.

detail.description: What the check saw; never file contents.
